item.title: Garrett Ford Sr. dead at 80
item.description: Ford was the first WVU football player to rush for 1,000 yards in a season and 2,000 for a career. He later served as an assistant coach for the Mountaineers and held various academic and administrative roles at WVU. The post Garrett Ford Sr. dead at 80 appeared first on WV MetroNews.

item.title: 3 Guys Before The Game – WVU Basketball vs Ohio State Recap (Episode 683)
item.description: An 89–88 double-overtime loss always stings—especially one that slipped away late.
